title: Trump compares White House UFC arena to Eiffel Tower, hints it could stay permanently
summary: In a video posted to his official Tiktok account on Wednesday, US President Donald Trump suggested he may never remove the enormous UFC arena that’s being constructed on the White House lawn for his birthday celebrations.
